projects.title: EUFL
projects.desc: Rebranding a professional European Ultimate Frisbee league for my bachelor project.

blocks.text: For my bachelor project, I created a complete rebrand for a professional European Ultimate Frisbee league, with clubs from across Europe: Brussels Blades, Rotterdam Rangers, Berlin Eagles, Stockholm Frost and Madrid Sol.
I developed the main EUFL identity and a visual direction that could carry through the league's club identities, graphics and motion work.
Each club received its own visual identity, while sharing a clear connection to the wider EUFL brand.
I brought the identity into motion through animated sports graphics and social content, including team-specific goal animations.
The social campaign includes hype posts, promotional visuals and content for individual teams.
A motion-based explainer uses animation and graphics to make the rules of Ultimate Frisbee easier to follow.
The final project was presented as a series of 12 A4 posters, each showing a different part of the EUFL identity.
